Turn aborted by a provider/network error for copilot: one user prompt whose model call never succeeds, asserting the ready→working→ready arc. LIVE-VERIFIED SETTLE MECHANISM (CLI 1.0.77, 2026-08-02): the aborted turn writes a persisted assistant.turn_end BEFORE session.error (21:44:10.483 turn_end, 21:44:10.498 session.error{errorType:query,statusCode:503}), so the copilot parser's existing evTurnEnd→turn_done mapping settles working→ready. There is NO assistant.message on an aborted turn, so the settle is carried purely by the explicit turn boundary — unlike claudecode/pi, which settle on a synthesized error epilogue. Recovery is event-driven: there is no working-state idle sweep (pid_manager TTL-cleans only ready/PID-dead sessions), so if turn_end were absent this cell would be daemon=bug — it is not. ELICITATION: BYOK (COPILOT_PROVIDER_BASE_URL) pointed at a dead port, so every model call is refused and the abort is deterministic; BYOK bypasses GitHub CAPI so the recording spends ZERO AI credits. Recorded with the INTERACTIVE driver — the REPL survives the abort (verified live), so the settled ready state is observed on a live session rather than raced against teardown. PRESESSION SHAPE (provisional, templated from the basic-turn sibling): copilot creates session-state/<id>/ at launch but writes events.jsonl only on the first prompt, so a proc-<PID> row is minted first and the real session arrives under a DIFFERENT id; every post-birth phase anchors to the REAL session. turn_aborted anchors to first_turn_start (not session_birth) so the matcher picks the post-abort ready rather than the birth ready. OBSERVATIONS: neither cost_nonzero nor tokens_nonzero is asserted — an aborted turn writes no assistant.message (the live outputTokens path contributes nothing) and session.shutdown reported modelMetrics:{} in the probe; model is NOT pinned because the BYOK id passes through NormalizeModelName and record fills it from the recording.

RECORDED 2026-08-05 (CLI 1.0.78) — the existential question is now settled from a recording, not from a probe. events.jsonl: user.message 15:29:08.796 → assistant.turn_start 15:29:08.969 → assistant.turn_end 15:29:15.530 → session.error 15:29:15.536 ("Could not connect to local model provider at http://127.0.0.1:18799/v1"). The turn_end lands 6ms BEFORE the error, so the parser's existing evTurnEnd → turn_done mapping settles the session working → ready at 17:29:15.644 with no adapter change needed. A retry ladder of ~6.6s against a refused connection, and the REPL survives — the session stays usable rather than racing process teardown. BIRTH RE-ANCHORED: the real session is born directly into `working` (commit 3cde4f8d), so session_birth and first_turn_start are ONE phase. COST/TOKENS ARE DELIBERATELY UNASSERTED and observations carries only `agent`: this cell runs BYOK, so the model label is the synthetic irrlicht-turn-abort-model, the capacity map has no pricing for it (the daemon logs `no pricing for model "irrlicht-turn-abort-model"`), and the aborted turn produced no assistant.message and therefore no outputTokens. Zero cost here is correct, not a regression — it is the price of recording this arc without spending AI credits.
